quotes.text: Software is a great combination of artistry and engineering.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.text: Code is the language in which we describe the world and the means by which we turn descriptions into reality.
quotes.author: John McCarthy

quotes.text: The computer is a bicycle for our minds.

quotes.author: Donald Knuth
